title: Long-trip comfort and ease
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the car as comfortable, easy to handle, and relaxing on longer journeys, while several undetermined snippets mention long trips without a clear evaluative stance.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise long-trip comfort, low fatigue, easy handling, and helpful driver-assistance or driving features on longer journeys.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets mention long trips, future travel plans, or unclear buyer-related comments, and some examples do not provide a clear sentiment despite sounding favorable.
